newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PSC Industries shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PSC Industries shares suspended.

text.p: Shares of PSC Industries Bhd were suspended from trading on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday afternoon, pending an announcement by the company, said an official at the exchange.
The shares were last traded on Thursday at 31.25 ringgit, up 6.95 ringgit from Tuesday's close.
PSC Industries is a shipbuilding company controlled by Malay tycoon Amin Shah Omar Shar.

In December PSC said it was to acquire the remaining 30 percent of Penang Shipbuilding and Construction Sdn Bhd it does not already own from Business Focus Sdn Bhd, Amin Shah's privately-owned company.

PSC also said in December it was to acquire a 40 percent stake in the privatised Naval Dockyard Sdn Bhd. The privatisation of Naval Dockyard includes the building and delivery of 27 offshore patrol vessels to the Malaysian navy and the maintenance of the vessels for 15 years.
PSC company officials could not be reached for comment.
